help.repeat: Lets the node forward other nodes' packets. On by default for repeaters, off for room servers.
help.ownerInfo: Free text shown to people who connect. Up to 119 bytes. Empty by default.
help.guestPassword: Password for guest access. Leave it empty: a guest password gives users access to owner info and neighbours. Empty by default.
help.adminPassword: Sets a new admin password; any node using it joins the admin list. Up to 15 characters. Factory default is "password". Leave empty to keep the current one.
help.dutycycle: How long the repeater stays silent after each transmission, in percent of airtime. Choose a value valid where you live (the EU 868 MHz band requires 10%). Options 1, 10, 50 or 100. Firmware default is about 50%.
help.floodAdvertHours: How often the node announces itself across the whole mesh, in hours. 3 to 168, or 0 to turn it off. Default is 47.
help.advertIntervalMinutes: How often the node announces itself to direct neighbours only, in minutes. 60 to 240 in steps of 2, or 0 to turn it off. Default is 0.
help.floodMaxUnscoped: Most hops a flood packet without a region may take. 0 to 64. Needs firmware 1.16 or newer.
help.floodMaxAdvert: Most hops a flooded advert may take. 0 to 64. The official tool lists 16 as default. Needs firmware 1.16 or newer.
help.floodMax: Most hops a flood packet may take. 0 to 64. Default is 64.
help.pathHashMode: Size of node IDs in adverts. 0 is 1 byte (256 IDs, up to 64 flood hops), 1 is 2 bytes (65K IDs, up to 32 hops), 2 is 3 bytes (16M IDs, up to 21 hops). Default is 0. Needs firmware 1.14 or newer; older firmware drops packets with longer hashes.
help.loopDetect: Drops flood packets that seem to loop. Off, minimal, moderate or strict, from lenient to strict. Default is off. Needs firmware 1.14 or newer.
help.txdelay: Delay factor before retransmitting flood traffic. 0 to 2. Default is 0.5.
help.directTxdelay: Delay factor before retransmitting direct traffic. 0 to 2. The official tool lists 0.2 as default.
help.rxdelay: Experimental delay before handling received traffic. 0 to 20. Default is 0.
help.radioRxgain: Boosted receive gain: better sensitivity for a small power cost. Not every radio supports it.
help.agcResetInterval: How often the receiver gain is reset, in seconds. Rounded down to a multiple of 4. 0 turns it off. Default is 0.
help.multiAcks: Sends extra acknowledgements for better delivery. Off by default.
help.txPower: Transmit power of the LoRa chip in dBm, 1 to 22. Some boards add an amplifier. Too high may break local rules.
error.option: Pick one of the listed options.
error.tooLong: Too long. The admin password allows 15 bytes.

connect.title: Connect your repeater
connect.sub: Plug it in with a USB cable. Works in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
connect.unplugged: The repeater was disconnected. Plug it in and connect again to continue.
connect.noSerial: This browser can't talk to USB devices (Web Serial is missing, as in Firefox and Safari). Use Chrome or Edge on a computer to connect a repeater. You can still build the script here and enter it yourself.
read.title: Read settings from repeater?
read.hint: This overwrites the form with values from the connected device. Admin password cannot be read from the device.
read.done_one: Read {count} setting. The next steps start from what the repeater has now.
read.done_other: Read {count} settings. The next steps start from what the repeater has now.
read.missing: No reply to: {commands}. Those fields keep the #BEmesh defaults.
place.title: Where is your repeater?
place.sub: Search a place, or click the map and drag the pin.
place.outside: This spot is outside Belgium. The name prefix and the regions need a place in Belgium: search for one or move the pin.
place.name: Name
place.nearbyOk: ✓ No node within {km} km uses this name
place.nearbyTaken: ⚠ Name already used nearby: {name} is within {km} km.
place.nearbyUnchecked: Couldn't check nearby names: the node list did not load.
read.linkLost: the repeater was disconnected during the Read. Nothing was changed.
place.clearHint: Remove the coordinates: no position is sent to the repeater. The chosen place stays.
place.noBorders: The municipality borders didn't load, so the place can't be detected from the map. Use the search to choose it.
